suite: the map (Map . Classic, the counts, the one selection on four surfaces, the view)
expect_red: [real] a part selected in the tree while its box is off the map's region is panned into view, at the reader's zoom

mutations.contract: A selection made elsewhere is panned into view when it is off the region.
mutations.note: Leaves the view where it was.
mutations.find: var moved = VA.mapBringIntoView(view, target, size.width, size.height, 24);
mutations.replace: var moved = view; /* mutated: a selection elsewhere is not brought into view */
